(* SIL-3 Hardwired Emergency Stop Relay Evaluation *)

    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bGridConnected := FALSE;

    iState := 90; (* Forced immediate transition to Emergency Hot Purge *)

(* Manual Fault Reset & Acknowledge Logic *)

        dwAlarmWord_2 := 16#0000_0000;

(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS WITH DIAGNOSTICS                    *)
(* Evaluates 9 critical process triplets: Current, Voltage, Fuel Flow, Supply Press, Motive Press,   *)
(* AGR Suction Flow, S/C Ratio, Core Temps (Inlet, Outlet, Mid), EIS ASRs, Cathode Air, Exhaust O2.  *)
(* Voting architecture:                                                                              *)
(*   - If all 3 match within tolerance -> Mean of 3, 3 channels healthy                             *)
(*   - If 2 match, 1 deviates -> Mean of matching 2, flag failed channel, degraded mode               *)
(*   - If none match -> Discrepancy trip, fail safe                                                  *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)

(* --- 2.1 Stack DC Busbar Current 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rDiff_AB := ABS(rStackCurrent_A - rStackCurrent_B);
rDiff_BC := ABS(rStackCurrent_B - rStackCurrent_C);
rDiff_CA := ABS(rStackCurrent_C - rStackCurrent_A);

IF (rDiff_AB <= rTol_Current_A) AND (rDiff_BC <= rTol_Current_A) AND (rDiff_CA <= rTol_Current_A) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent := (rStackCurrent_A + rStackCurrent_B + rStackCurrent_C) / 3.0;
    wSensorHealth_Current := 16#0007; (* Channels A, B, C Healthy *)
ELSIF (rDiff_AB <= rTol_Current_A) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent := (rStackCurrent_A + rStackCurrent_B) * 0.5;
    wSensorHealth_Current := 16#0003; (* Channel C Failed *)
    dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Current Sensor C Discrepancy *)
ELSIF (rDiff_BC <= rTol_Current_A) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent := (rStackCurrent_B + rStackCurrent_C) * 0.5;
    wSensorHealth_Current := 16#0006; (* Channel A Failed *)
    dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Current Sensor A Discrepancy *)
ELSIF (rDiff_CA <= rTol_Current_A) THEN
    rVoted_StackCurrent := (rStackCurrent_C + rStackCurrent_A) * 0.5;
    wSensorHealth_Current := 16#0005; (* Channel B Failed *)
    dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Current Sensor B Discrepancy *)
ELSE
    rVoted_StackCurrent := rStackCurrent_A; (* Fallback Unsafe *)
    wSensorHealth_Current := 16#0000;
    dwAlarmWord_3 := dwAlarmWord_3 OR 16#0000_0007; (* Full Triplet Current Discrepancy Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    iState := 90;
END_IF;

(* 3.0 IN-SITU ELECTROCHEMICAL, THERMODYNAMIC & KINETIC OBSERVER                                    *)
(* Calculates real-time Nernst potential, Butler-Volmer overpotentials, internal methane reforming   *)

(* ================================================================================================= *)

(* --- 3.1 Mean Stack Current Density & DC Electrical Power --- *)
rCurrentDensity_A_cm2 := rVoted_StackCurrent / (rCellActiveArea_cm2 * 4.0); (* 4 Stacks in Parallel *)

(* --- 3.2 Temperature-Dependent Reversible Nernst Potential --- *)
(* Standard potential E0 as function of absolute temperature: E0(T) = 1.2723 - 2.7645e-4 * T [K] *)
rTempCalc1 := 1.2723 - (0.00027645 * rStackTempCore_Kelvin);
(* Nernst logarithmic partial pressure quotient: ln( [P_H2 * sqrt(P_O2)] / P_H2O ) *)
rTempCalc2 := (rPartialPress_H2 * SQRT(0.185)) / (rPartialPress_H2O + 0.0001);
IF rTempCalc2 > 0.001 THEN
    rTempCalc3 := LN(rTempCalc2);
ELSE
    rTempCalc3 := -6.907;
END_IF;

rNernstPotential_V := rTempCalc1 + ((rConst_R_gas * rStackTempCore_Kelvin) / (2.0 * rConst_Faraday)) * rTempCalc3;

(* --- 3.3 Stack Overpotentials (Ohmic, Butler-Volmer Activation, Gas Concentration) --- *)
(* Ohmic ASR Loss (using voted high-frequency EIS resistance) *)
rOhmicOverpotential_V := rCurrentDensity_A_cm2 * (rVoted_EIS_ASR_Ohmic * 0.001);

(* Activation Overpotential: Butler-Volmer hyperbolic sine approximation *)
rTempCalc4 := rCurrentDensity_A_cm2 / (2.0 * 0.150); (* Exchange current density j0 = 0.15 A/cm2 *)
(* arsinh(y) = ln(y + sqrt(y^2 + 1)) *)
rActivationLoss_V := ((2.0 * rConst_R_gas * rStackTempCore_Kelvin) / rConst_Faraday) * LN(rTempCalc4 + SQRT((rTempCalc4 * rTempCalc4) + 1.0));

(* Concentration Overpotential: Gas diffusion boundary layer limitations *)
IF rCurrentDensity_A_cm2 < 1.80 THEN
    rConcentrationLoss_V := -((rConst_R_gas * rStackTempCore_Kelvin) / (2.0 * rConst_Faraday)) * LN(1.0 - (rCurrentDensity_A_cm2 / 2.20));
ELSE
    rConcentrationLoss_V := 0.250; (* Diffusional saturation clamp *)
END_IF;

(* --- 3.4 Direct Internal Reforming (DIR) Kinetics & Endothermic Heat Sink --- *)
(* Xu-Froment rate formulation for catalytic steam reforming: CH4 + H2O <=> CO + 3H2 *)
rTempCalc1 := EXP(-82000.0 / (rConst_R_gas * rStackTempCore_Kelvin)); (* Arrhenius kinetic constant *)
rTempCalc2 := EXP(26830.0 / rStackTempCore_Kelvin - 30.114); (* Reforming equilibrium constant Kp1 *)
rReformingRate_mol_s := (rVoted_FuelFlow_CH4 / 22.414 / 3600.0) * 1000.0 * 0.75; (* Local reforming throughput *)
(* Endothermic cooling power: Delta H = +206.1 kJ/mol *)
rEndothermicCooling_kW := rReformingRate_mol_s * 206.1 * 0.001 * (1.0 - (rPreReformerBypass_Cmd * 0.008));

rShiftRate_mol_s := rReformingRate_mol_s * 0.65; (* Near-equilibrium shift yield *)

    rEjectorEntrainmentTheor := rEjectorIsentropicEff * (SQRT(rTempCalc1) * 1.65 * SQRT((320.0 * rEjectorSecondaryMixM) / (rStackTempCore_Kelvin * rEjectorPrimaryMotiveM)) - 0.95);

rTempCalc1 := EXP(20670.0 / rStackTempCore_Kelvin - 20.97);
rBoudouardCarbonActivity := rTempCalc1 * ((rPartialPress_CO * rPartialPress_CO) / (rPartialPress_CO2 + 0.001));

(* Methane Cracking Equilibrium: CH4 <=> C(s) + 2H2, ln(Km) = -8970 / T + 12.85 *)
rTempCalc2 := EXP(-8970.0 / rStackTempCore_Kelvin + 12.85);
rCrackingCarbonActivity := rTempCalc2 * (rPartialPress_CH4 / ((rPartialPress_H2 * rPartialPress_H2) + 0.001));

(* Worst-Case Local Carbon Deposition Potential *)
IF rBoudouardCarbonActivity > rCrackingCarbonActivity THEN
    rMaxCarbonActivity := rBoudouardCarbonActivity;
ELSE
    rMaxCarbonActivity := rCrackingCarbonActivity;
END_IF;

(* --- 4.2 Dynamic Carbon Coking Severity Accumulation --- *)
(* If thermodynamic activity ac > 1.00, carbon formation is energetically favorable *)
IF rMaxCarbonActivity > 1.00 THEN
    (* Growth rate proportional to thermodynamic driving force and polarization deviation *)
    rCokingGrowthRate_pct_h := (rMaxCarbonActivity - 1.00) * 1.85 * (1.0 + (rEIS_DeltaPolar_ASR * 0.02));
    rCokingAccumulator := rCokingAccumulator + (rCokingGrowthRate_pct_h * (0.50 / 3600.0)); (* 0.5s scan *)
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Carbon Coking Thermodynamic Onset Warning *)
ELSE
    (* Passive carbon gasification: C + H2O => CO + H2 at high steam ratio *)
    IF (rVoted_SteamToCarbon > 2.40) AND (rCokingAccumulator > 0.0) THEN
        rCokingGrowthRate_pct_h := -0.45 * (rVoted_SteamToCarbon - 2.0);
        rCokingAccumulator := rCokingAccumulator + (rCokingGrowthRate_pct_h * (0.50 / 3600.0));
        IF rCokingAccumulator < 0.0 THEN
            rCokingAccumulator := 0.0;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rCokingGrowthRate_pct_h := 0.0;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

rCokingSeverityIndex_Pct := rCokingAccumulator;

(* Decoking Trigger Request Logic *)
IF (rCokingSeverityIndex_Pct > 35.0) OR (rEIS_DeltaPolar_ASR > 180.0) OR bDecokingOverrideCmd THEN
    bDecokingTriggerReq := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Active Decoking Pulse Regeneration Required *)
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 PLANAR AXIAL THERMAL GRADIENT OBSERVER & CERAMIC ELECTROLYTE STRESS                           *)
(* Direct internal methane reforming (DIR) is strongly endothermic (Delta H = +206.1 kJ/mol),       *)
(* causing localized temperature depression near the fuel inlet. This section computes the 5-node   *)
(* spatial profile and estimates maximum ceramic shear stress to prevent structural rupture.         *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)

(* 5-Node Discretization along Planar Flow Axis (x = 0 to x = 25 cm) *)
rTemp_Node_1_Inlet := rVoted_StackTemp_Inlet;
(* Node 2: Reforming reaction peak zone subject to cooling depression *)
rTemp_Node_2_PreRef := rTemp_Node_1_Inlet + (0.35 * (rVoted_StackTemp_Mid - rTemp_Node_1_Inlet)) - (rEndothermicCooling_kW * 0.085);
rTemp_Node_3_Mid := rVoted_StackTemp_Mid;
rTemp_Node_4_PostRef := rTemp_Node_3_Mid + (0.60 * (rVoted_StackTemp_Outlet - rTemp_Node_3_Mid));
rTemp_Node_5_Outlet := rVoted_StackTemp_Outlet;

(* Local Axial Thermal Gradients: |Delta T| / Delta x [K/cm] *)
rGrad_12_K_per_cm := ABS(rTemp_Node_2_PreRef - rTemp_Node_1_Inlet) / rDelta_X_Node_cm;
rGrad_23_K_per_cm := ABS(rTemp_Node_3_Mid - rTemp_Node_2_PreRef) / rDelta_X_Node_cm;
rGrad_34_K_per_cm := ABS(rTemp_Node_4_PostRef - rTemp_Node_3_Mid) / rDelta_X_Node_cm;
rGrad_45_K_per_cm := ABS(rTemp_Node_5_Outlet - rTemp_Node_4_PostRef) / rDelta_X_Node_cm;

(* Peak Spatial Gradient Identification *)
rMaxLocalGradient := rGrad_12_K_per_cm;
IF rGrad_23_K_per_cm > rMaxLocalGradient THEN
    rMaxLocalGradient := rGrad_23_K_per_cm;
END_IF;
IF rGrad_34_K_per_cm > rMaxLocalGradient THEN
    rMaxLocalGradient := rGrad_34_K_per_cm;
END_IF;
IF rGrad_45_K_per_cm > rMaxLocalGradient THEN
    rMaxLocalGradient := rGrad_45_K_per_cm;
END_IF;

rMaxThermalGradient_K_per_cm := rMaxLocalGradient;

(* Ceramic Electrolyte Shear Stress: sigma = (E * alpha * Grad * L) / (2 * (1 - nu)) [MPa] *)
rElectrolyteThermalStress_MPa := (rElectrolyteModulus_GPa * 1000.0 * (rThermalExpansion_ppm_K * 1.0E-6) * rMaxThermalGradient_K_per_cm * rCellLength_cm) / (2.0 * (1.0 - rPoissonRatio));

(* Thermal Gradient Alarm & Protection Evaluation *)
IF rMaxThermalGradient_K_per_cm > 1.80 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* High Thermal Gradient Warning *)
END_IF;
IF rMaxThermalGradient_K_per_cm > 3.00 THEN
    dwAlarmWord_1 := dwAlarmWord_1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Ceramic Rupture Critical Gradient Trip *)
    bSystemTrip := TRUE;
    iState := 90;
END_IF;

(* ================================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 6-STATE CONSTRAINED MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) & GAIN-SCHEDULED FALLBACK                  *)
(* Solves real-time quadratic cost optimization:                                                     *)
(*   min J = sum( (x_k - x_sp)^T * Q * (x_k - x_sp) + Delta_u_k^T * R * Delta_u_k )                 *)
(* Analytical Newton step with 4x4 Hessian condition monitoring and bump-free PID fallback.          *)
(* ================================================================================================= *)

(* --- 6.1 State Deviation Formulation --- *)
x1_Dev_TempCore := rStackCoreTemp_Avg - 750.0;                       (* Target 750 deg C *)
x2_Dev_ThermGrad := rMaxThermalGradient_K_per_cm - 1.20;             (* Target 1.20 K/cm *)
x3_Dev_RecircRatio := rAnodeRecircRatio_Actual - 2.80;               (* Target entrainment 2.80 *)
x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon := rCalculated_SC_Ratio - rTargetSC_Ratio;      (* Target S/C setpoint *)
x5_Dev_PolarASR := rEIS_DeltaPolar_ASR;                              (* Target zero polarization increase *)
x6_Dev_FuelUtil := rFuelUtilization_Pct - 75.0;                      (* Target 75% fuel utilization *)

(* --- 6.2 1-Step Ahead State Prediction: x(k+1) = Ad*x(k) + Bd*u(k-1) --- *)
x1_Pred_Next := (Ad_11 * x1_Dev_TempCore) + (Ad_12 * x2_Dev_ThermGrad) + (Ad_13 * x3_Dev_RecircRatio) +
                (Ad_14 * x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon) + (Ad_15 * x5_Dev_PolarASR) + (Ad_16 * x6_Dev_FuelUtil) +
                (Bd_11 * rEjectorNeedle_Prev) + (Bd_12 * rFuelFlowValve_Prev) + (Bd_13 * rCathodeBlower_Prev) + (Bd_14 * rPreRefBypass_Prev);

x2_Pred_Next := (Ad_21 * x1_Dev_TempCore) + (Ad_22 * x2_Dev_ThermGrad) + (Ad_23 * x3_Dev_RecircRatio) +
                (Ad_24 * x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon) + (Ad_25 * x5_Dev_PolarASR) + (Ad_26 * x6_Dev_FuelUtil) +
                (Bd_21 * rEjectorNeedle_Prev) + (Bd_22 * rFuelFlowValve_Prev) + (Bd_23 * rCathodeBlower_Prev) + (Bd_24 * rPreRefBypass_Prev);

x3_Pred_Next := (Ad_31 * x1_Dev_TempCore) + (Ad_32 * x2_Dev_ThermGrad) + (Ad_33 * x3_Dev_RecircRatio) +
                (Ad_34 * x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon) + (Ad_35 * x5_Dev_PolarASR) + (Ad_36 * x6_Dev_FuelUtil) +
                (Bd_31 * rEjectorNeedle_Prev) + (Bd_32 * rFuelFlowValve_Prev) + (Bd_33 * rCathodeBlower_Prev) + (Bd_34 * rPreRefBypass_Prev);

x4_Pred_Next := (Ad_41 * x1_Dev_TempCore) + (Ad_42 * x2_Dev_ThermGrad) + (Ad_43 * x3_Dev_RecircRatio) +
                (Ad_44 * x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon) + (Ad_45 * x5_Dev_PolarASR) + (Ad_46 * x6_Dev_FuelUtil) +
                (Bd_41 * rEjectorNeedle_Prev) + (Bd_42 * rFuelFlowValve_Prev) + (Bd_43 * rCathodeBlower_Prev) + (Bd_44 * rPreRefBypass_Prev);

x5_Pred_Next := (Ad_51 * x1_Dev_TempCore) + (Ad_52 * x2_Dev_ThermGrad) + (Ad_53 * x3_Dev_RecircRatio) +
                (Ad_54 * x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon) + (Ad_55 * x5_Dev_PolarASR) + (Ad_56 * x6_Dev_FuelUtil) +
                (Bd_51 * rEjectorNeedle_Prev) + (Bd_52 * rFuelFlowValve_Prev) + (Bd_53 * rCathodeBlower_Prev) + (Bd_54 * rPreRefBypass_Prev);

x6_Pred_Next := (Ad_61 * x1_Dev_TempCore) + (Ad_62 * x2_Dev_ThermGrad) + (Ad_63 * x3_Dev_RecircRatio) +
                (Ad_64 * x4_Dev_SteamToCarbon) + (Ad_65 * x5_Dev_PolarASR) + (Ad_66 * x6_Dev_FuelUtil) +
                (Bd_61 * rEjectorNeedle_Prev) + (Bd_62 * rFuelFlowValve_Prev) + (Bd_63 * rCathodeBlower_Prev) + (Bd_64 * rPreRefBypass_Prev);

(* --- 6.3 Quadratic Cost Gradient Vector: g = Bd^T * Q * x_pred + R * Delta_u_prev --- *)
rGrad_1 := (Bd_11 * rMPC_Q_TempCore * x1_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_21 * rMPC_Q_ThermGrad * x2_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_31 * rMPC_Q_RecircRatio * x3_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_41 * rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon * x4_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_51 * rMPC_Q_PolarASR * x5_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_61 * rMPC_Q_FuelUtil * x6_Pred_Next);

rGrad_2 := (Bd_12 * rMPC_Q_TempCore * x1_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_22 * rMPC_Q_ThermGrad * x2_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_32 * rMPC_Q_RecircRatio * x3_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_42 * rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon * x4_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_52 * rMPC_Q_PolarASR * x5_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_62 * rMPC_Q_FuelUtil * x6_Pred_Next);

rGrad_3 := (Bd_13 * rMPC_Q_TempCore * x1_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_23 * rMPC_Q_ThermGrad * x2_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_33 * rMPC_Q_RecircRatio * x3_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_43 * rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon * x4_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_53 * rMPC_Q_PolarASR * x5_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_63 * rMPC_Q_FuelUtil * x6_Pred_Next);

rGrad_4 := (Bd_14 * rMPC_Q_TempCore * x1_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_24 * rMPC_Q_ThermGrad * x2_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_34 * rMPC_Q_RecircRatio * x3_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_44 * rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon * x4_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_54 * rMPC_Q_PolarASR * x5_Pred_Next) +
           (Bd_64 * rMPC_Q_FuelUtil * x6_Pred_Next);

(* --- 6.4 Hessian Matrix Elements: H = Bd^T * Q * Bd + R --- *)
rHess_11 := (Bd_11*Bd_11*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_21*Bd_21*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_31*Bd_31*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) +
            (Bd_41*Bd_41*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_51*Bd_51*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_61*Bd_61*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil) + rMPC_R_dEjector;

rHess_22 := (Bd_12*Bd_12*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_22*Bd_22*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_32*Bd_32*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) +
            (Bd_42*Bd_42*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_52*Bd_52*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_62*Bd_62*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil) + rMPC_R_dFuel;

rHess_33 := (Bd_13*Bd_13*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_23*Bd_23*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_33*Bd_33*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) +
            (Bd_43*Bd_43*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_53*Bd_53*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_63*Bd_63*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil) + rMPC_R_dAir;

rHess_44 := (Bd_14*Bd_14*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_24*Bd_24*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_34*Bd_34*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) +
            (Bd_44*Bd_44*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_54*Bd_54*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_64*Bd_64*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil) + rMPC_R_dBypass;

(* Cross-couplings *)
rHess_12 := (Bd_11*Bd_12*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_21*Bd_22*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_31*Bd_32*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) + (Bd_41*Bd_42*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_51*Bd_52*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_61*Bd_62*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil);
rHess_21 := rHess_12;

rHess_13 := (Bd_11*Bd_13*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_21*Bd_23*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_31*Bd_33*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) + (Bd_41*Bd_43*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_51*Bd_53*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_61*Bd_63*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil);
rHess_31 := rHess_13;

rHess_14 := (Bd_11*Bd_14*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_21*Bd_24*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_31*Bd_34*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) + (Bd_41*Bd_44*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_51*Bd_54*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_61*Bd_64*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil);
rHess_41 := rHess_14;

rHess_23 := (Bd_12*Bd_13*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_22*Bd_23*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_32*Bd_33*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) + (Bd_42*Bd_43*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_52*Bd_53*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_62*Bd_63*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil);
rHess_32 := rHess_23;

rHess_24 := (Bd_12*Bd_14*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_22*Bd_24*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_32*Bd_34*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) + (Bd_42*Bd_44*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_52*Bd_54*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_62*Bd_64*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil);
rHess_42 := rHess_24;

rHess_34 := (Bd_13*Bd_14*rMPC_Q_TempCore) + (Bd_23*Bd_24*rMPC_Q_ThermGrad) + (Bd_33*Bd_34*rMPC_Q_RecircRatio) + (Bd_43*Bd_44*rMPC_Q_SteamToCarbon) + (Bd_53*Bd_54*rMPC_Q_PolarASR) + (Bd_63*Bd_64*rMPC_Q_FuelUtil);
rHess_43 := rHess_34;

(* --- 6.5 Hessian Determinant & Numerical Conditioning Check --- *)
rHessianDeterminant := (rHess_11 * rHess_22 * rHess_33 * rHess_44) - (rHess_12 * rHess_21 * rHess_33 * rHess_44);
IF rHessianDeterminant < 0.00001 THEN
    bMPCMatrixIllConditioned := TRUE;
    bDegradedControlMode := TRUE;
    dwAlarmWord_2 := dwAlarmWord_2 OR 16#0000_0020; (* MPC Ill-Conditioned Matrix Warning *)
ELSE
    bMPCMatrixIllConditioned := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* --- 6.6 Optimal Incremental Step or Fallback Decoupled PID Execution --- *)
IF NOT bMPCMatrixIllConditioned AND NOT bDegradedControlMode THEN
    (* Unconstrained Newton step: Delta_u = -H^(-1) * g *)
    rDeltaU_Opt_Ejector := -rGrad_1 / (rHess_11 + 0.001);
    rDeltaU_Opt_Fuel    := -rGrad_2 / (rHess_22 + 0.001);
    rDeltaU_Opt_Air     := -rGrad_3 / (rHess_33 + 0.001);
    rDeltaU_Opt_Bypass  := -rGrad_4 / (rHess_44 + 0.001);
ELSE
    (* Fallback Decoupled Gain-Scheduled PID Controllers *)
    (* Loop 1: S/C Ratio -> Ejector Spindle Actuator *)
    rPID_Err_SC := rTargetSC_Ratio - rCalculated_SC_Ratio;
    rPID_Integ_SC := rPID_Integ_SC + (rPID_Err_SC * 0.50 * 0.15);
    IF rPID_Integ_SC > 25.0 THEN rPID_Integ_SC := 25.0; ELSIF rPID_Integ_SC < -25.0 THEN rPID_Integ_SC := -25.0; END_IF;
    rPID_Deriv_SC := (rPID_Err_SC - rPID_PrevErr_SC) / 0.50;
    rPID_PrevErr_SC := rPID_Err_SC;
    rDeltaU_Opt_Ejector := (12.5 * rPID_Err_SC) + rPID_Integ_SC + (1.8 * rPID_Deriv_SC);

    (* Loop 2: Net Electrical Power -> Fresh CH4 Fuel Valve *)
    rPID_Err_Power := (rTargetNetPower_kW - rNetElectricalPower_kW) * 0.001;
    rPID_Integ_Power := rPID_Integ_Power + (rPID_Err_Power * 0.50 * 0.25);
    IF rPID_Integ_Power > 20.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Power := 20.0; ELSIF rPID_Integ_Power < -20.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Power := -20.0; END_IF;
    rPID_Deriv_Power := (rPID_Err_Power - rPID_PrevErr_Power) / 0.50;
    rPID_PrevErr_Power := rPID_Err_Power;
    rDeltaU_Opt_Fuel := (8.0 * rPID_Err_Power) + rPID_Integ_Power + (0.95 * rPID_Deriv_Power);

    (* Loop 3: Stack Core Temperature -> Cathode Cooling Air Blower *)
    rPID_Err_Temp := rStackCoreTemp_Avg - 750.0;
    rPID_Integ_Temp := rPID_Integ_Temp + (rPID_Err_Temp * 0.50 * 0.08);
    IF rPID_Integ_Temp > 30.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Temp := 30.0; ELSIF rPID_Integ_Temp < -30.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Temp := -30.0; END_IF;
    rPID_Deriv_Temp := (rPID_Err_Temp - rPID_PrevErr_Temp) / 0.50;
    rPID_PrevErr_Temp := rPID_Err_Temp;
    rDeltaU_Opt_Air := (3.5 * rPID_Err_Temp) + rPID_Integ_Temp + (1.2 * rPID_Deriv_Temp);

    (* Loop 4: Thermal Gradient -> Pre-Reformer Bypass Valve *)
    rPID_Err_Grad := rMaxThermalGradient_K_per_cm - 1.20;
    rPID_Integ_Grad := rPID_Integ_Grad + (rPID_Err_Grad * 0.50 * 0.12);
    IF rPID_Integ_Grad > 20.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Grad := 20.0; ELSIF rPID_Integ_Grad < -20.0 THEN rPID_Integ_Grad := -20.0; END_IF;
    rPID_Deriv_Grad := (rPID_Err_Grad - rPID_PrevErr_Grad) / 0.50;
    rPID_PrevErr_Grad := rPID_Err_Grad;
    rDeltaU_Opt_Bypass := (15.0 * rPID_Err_Grad) + rPID_Integ_Grad + (2.5 * rPID_Deriv_Grad);
END_IF;

(* Rate Limit Clamping on Incremental Commands *)
IF rDeltaU_Opt_Ejector > rMaxDelta_Ejector_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Ejector := rMaxDelta_Ejector_pct; ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_Ejector < -rMaxDelta_Ejector_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Ejector := -rMaxDelta_Ejector_pct; END_IF;
IF rDeltaU_Opt_Fuel > rMaxDelta_Fuel_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Fuel := rMaxDelta_Fuel_pct; ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_Fuel < -rMaxDelta_Fuel_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Fuel := -rMaxDelta_Fuel_pct; END_IF;
IF rDeltaU_Opt_Air > rMaxDelta_Air_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Air := rMaxDelta_Air_pct; ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_Air < -rMaxDelta_Air_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Air := -rMaxDelta_Air_pct; END_IF;
IF rDeltaU_Opt_Bypass > rMaxDelta_Bypass_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Bypass := rMaxDelta_Bypass_pct; ELSIF rDeltaU_Opt_Bypass < -rMaxDelta_Bypass_pct THEN rDeltaU_Opt_Bypass := -rMaxDelta_Bypass_pct; END_IF;

(* 7.0 MULTI-TIER ALARM TREE & COMPREHENSIVE BIT-PACKED STATUS ENCODING                             *)
(* Three-tier hierarchy: Category 1 (SIL-3 Safety Trips), Category 2 (Process Warnings),           *)
